'''Rox Durmak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] holo forger who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime between the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], Durmak helped the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] trick the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to keep the Imperials away from [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. He later hid on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where he was pursued by several [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] before fleeing the desert [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
